subject.title: fix(heartbeat): remove static iteration cap in seekNextActivePhaseDueMs

question: Should OpenClaw intentionally support accepted sub-minute heartbeat intervals with active-hours seeking by replacing the static 10,080 cap with this bounded 30-second batch/backward-walk algorithm?
rationale: The code change is a narrow bug fix, but it changes upgrade-visible scheduling behavior and synchronous predicate-call budget for existing small-interval heartbeat configs, which automation should not silently accept.

options.title: Land As Bounded Bug Fix
options.body: Merge after refreshing exact-head checks, treating the PR body and tests as the compatibility/performance note for supported small intervals.

options.title: Ask For Extra Timing Proof
options.body: Request one more production-path timing transcript for a 1ms inactive-to-active transition before deciding the availability budget is acceptable.

options.title: Pause For Interval Policy
options.body: Hold this PR if maintainers want to disallow or document stricter policy for second-level or sub-second heartbeat intervals instead of supporting them.

recommendation.title: Land As Bounded Bug Fix
recommendation.body: Merge after refreshing exact-head checks, treating the PR body and tests as the compatibility/performance note for supported small intervals.
